checks.title: Classic defects
items: `except:`/`except Exception: pass` that swallows failures, and bare `except` around I/O.

checks.title: Resources and concurrency
items: Threads/tasks started without a join/cancel path; shared state mutated without a lock.

checks.title: Data handling
items: `int()`/`float()`/`datetime` parsing on external input without handling the error.
Equality on floats where an epsilon is required.
